declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement in support of preliminary approval. In the first and only negotiation round, Whitcombe Reyes LLP proposed a $30 million class fund with automatic payments to identifiable class members, together with $5 million in separately paid attorneys’ fees and expenses, subject to court approval. The proposal provided that Brightline would not agree to refrain from opposing the fee request and that any fees not awarded would go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. Defense counsel accepted that complete term sheet in the same round. Class relief and fees were proposed together; they were not negotiated in separate stages. The court-ordered transcript supplies the complete record. The firm has invested approximately $3.1 million in attorney time and $0.4 million in expenses, and its only compensation in this case will be a court-approved fee. Counsel also faced overlapping actions whose counsel would receive no fee if this settlement were approved first. I disclose these interests so the court can independently scrutinize the settlement and fee request.
